product.title: Sacred Valley of the Inkas Full Day Tour

description.text: In Cusco, this full-day Sacred Valley outing covers Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Moray, Chinchero, and the Salinas de Maras salt mines in one published circuit. Lunch and a craft-workshop stop in colonial Chinchero are listed so the day stays with Inka sites rather than a self-drive ticket hop. Shared transport handles the valley distances across the 11-to-12-hour window. The format suits visitors who want a longer guided sightseeing day without booking each ruin separately or coordinating Moray and Maras entrance cash on their own schedule. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on Pisac, Ollantaytambo, Moray, Chinchero, and Salinas de Maras that shape this valley day rather than a Machu Picchu train add-on or a city-ruins half day.

highlights: Visit the top five attractions in Peru’s Sacred Valley on a group tour from Cusco
